title: Chore and allowance system design for kids
description: Design a fair, age-appropriate chore and allowance system for a family's children, revise it against a fairness check, and get parent sign-off.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: chore-allowance-system
  title: Chore and allowance system design for kids
  description: Design a fair, age-appropriate chore and allowance system for a family's children, revise it against a fairness check, and get parent sign-off.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a workable, fair, age-appropriate chore and allowance system that the parents approve.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 2, onFailure: stop, requireApprovalFor: [approval] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Family context and constraints
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: "The children's ages, current chores, household goals, and any constraints the parents want reflected in the system." }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: draft
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Draft the chore and allowance system
      role: Designer of practical household chore and allowance systems for families.
      prompt: Draft a concrete chore and allowance system from the stated children's ages, existing chores, and household goals. Assign chores by age-appropriate difficulty, propose an allowance structure tied to completion, and state any assumptions you made about ages or expectations explicitly.
      capabilities: { skills: [domain-analysis], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [deliverable, assumptions], properties: { deliverable: { type: string }, assumptions: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
    - id: check
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Fairness and age-appropriateness check
      role: Independent evaluator focused on fairness across siblings and age-appropriateness of assigned chores.
      prompt: Score the draft system against fairness across children of different ages, age-appropriateness of each chore, clarity of the allowance rules, and whether effort and reward are proportionate. Return a score, a pass/fail verdict, and specific reasons.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [score, passed, reasons], properties: { score: { type: number }, passed: { type: boolean }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.85 }
    - id: revise
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Revise the chore and allowance system
      role: Revision specialist for household systems.
      prompt: Revise the chore and allowance system using the evaluator's specific findings on fairness and age-appropriateness. Preserve the parts of the system that already worked well and explain what changed and why.
      capabilities: { skills: [domain-analysis], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [deliverable, resolved], properties: { deliverable: { type: string }, resolved: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
    - id: revision-loop
      kind: loop
      name: Revision loop
      config: { body: [check, revise], exitCondition: "check.passed == true", maxIterations: 2, onExhausted: warn }
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Parent sign-off
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Approved chore and allowance system
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: draft, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: draft, to: check, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: check, to: revise, kind: control, condition: "passed == false" }
    - { id: e3-pass, from: check, to: approval, kind: control, condition: "passed == true" }
    - { id: e4, from: revise, to: revision-loop, kind: dependency }
    - { id: e5, from: revision-loop, to: approval, kind: control, condition: loop_exit }
    - { id: e5-exhausted, from: revision-loop, to: approval, kind: control, condition: loop_exhausted }
    - { id: e6, from: approval, to: result, kind: dependency, condition: approved }
